```{r}
# ============================================================
# Stage 1: Import, synchronize, and audit community data
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(DESeq2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

counts_fp  <- "~/github/sbc_bioreactors/data/dada2_output/ASVs_counts-no-contam.tsv"
tax_fp     <- "~/github/sbc_bioreactors/data/dada2_output/ASVs_taxonomy-no-contam.tsv"
sample_fp  <- "~/github/sbc_bioreactors/data/sampleinfo.txt"

# Use full project paths instead if the files are elsewhere.
stopifnot(
  file.exists(counts_fp),
  file.exists(tax_fp),
  file.exists(sample_fp)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Import raw tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

count_tab <- read.delim(
  counts_fp,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

tax_tab <- read.delim(
  tax_fp,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

sample_info <- read.delim(
  sample_fp,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Convert taxonomy to a matrix for phyloseq.
tax_mat <- as.matrix(tax_tab)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Basic orientation checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("Raw dimensions\n")
cat("  Count table:", nrow(count_tab), "ASVs x",
    ncol(count_tab), "samples\n")
cat("  Taxonomy table:", nrow(tax_mat), "ASVs x",
    ncol(tax_mat), "ranks\n")
cat("  Metadata table:", nrow(sample_info), "samples x",
    ncol(sample_info), "variables\n\n")

# ASVs should be rows and samples should be columns.
n_sample_matches_columns <- sum(
  colnames(count_tab) %in% rownames(sample_info)
)

n_sample_matches_rows <- sum(
  rownames(count_tab) %in% rownames(sample_info)
)

cat("Metadata IDs matching count-table columns:",
    n_sample_matches_columns, "\n")
cat("Metadata IDs matching count-table rows:",
    n_sample_matches_rows, "\n\n")

if (n_sample_matches_rows > n_sample_matches_columns) {
  message("Transposing count table because samples appear to be rows.")
  count_tab <- as.data.frame(t(count_tab), check.names = FALSE)
}

# Confirm that counts are numeric.
count_tab[] <- lapply(count_tab, function(x) {
  as.numeric(as.character(x))
})

count_mat <- as.matrix(count_tab)
storage.mode(count_mat) <- "numeric"

if (anyNA(count_mat)) {
  stop(
    "NA values were introduced while converting the count table ",
    "to numeric. Inspect the input file."
  )
}

if (any(count_mat < 0)) {
  stop("Negative values detected in the ASV count table.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Synchronize ASVs between counts and taxonomy
# ------------------------------------------------------------

shared_asvs <- intersect(
  rownames(count_mat),
  rownames(tax_mat)
)

counts_only_asvs <- setdiff(
  rownames(count_mat),
  rownames(tax_mat)
)

taxonomy_only_asvs <- setdiff(
  rownames(tax_mat),
  rownames(count_mat)
)

cat("ASV synchronization\n")
cat("  Shared ASVs:", length(shared_asvs), "\n")
cat("  Count-only ASVs:", length(counts_only_asvs), "\n")
cat("  Taxonomy-only ASVs:", length(taxonomy_only_asvs), "\n\n")

if (length(shared_asvs) == 0) {
  stop("No ASV identifiers are shared between counts and taxonomy.")
}

count_mat <- count_mat[shared_asvs, , drop = FALSE]
tax_mat   <- tax_mat[shared_asvs, , drop = FALSE]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Synchronize samples between counts and metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

shared_samples <- intersect(
  rownames(sample_info),
  colnames(count_mat)
)

metadata_only_samples <- setdiff(
  rownames(sample_info),
  colnames(count_mat)
)

counts_only_samples <- setdiff(
  colnames(count_mat),
  rownames(sample_info)
)

cat("Sample synchronization\n")
cat("  Shared samples:", length(shared_samples), "\n")
cat("  Metadata-only samples:", length(metadata_only_samples), "\n")
cat("  Count-only samples:", length(counts_only_samples), "\n\n")

if (length(metadata_only_samples) > 0) {
  cat(
    "Metadata-only sample IDs:\n",
    paste(metadata_only_samples, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\n"
  )
}

if (length(counts_only_samples) > 0) {
  cat(
    "Count-only sample IDs:\n",
    paste(counts_only_samples, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\n"
  )
}

if (length(shared_samples) == 0) {
  stop("No sample identifiers are shared between counts and metadata.")
}

# Preserve the curated order in the metadata file.
shared_samples <- rownames(sample_info)[
  rownames(sample_info) %in% shared_samples
]

count_mat  <- count_mat[, shared_samples, drop = FALSE]
sample_info <- sample_info[shared_samples, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(count_mat), rownames(sample_info))
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Remove empty ASVs and empty samples, if any
# ------------------------------------------------------------

empty_asvs <- rowSums(count_mat) == 0
empty_samples <- colSums(count_mat) == 0

cat("Empty features and samples\n")
cat("  Empty ASVs:", sum(empty_asvs), "\n")
cat("  Empty samples:", sum(empty_samples), "\n\n")

if (any(empty_asvs)) {
  count_mat <- count_mat[!empty_asvs, , drop = FALSE]
  tax_mat   <- tax_mat[rownames(count_mat), , drop = FALSE]
}

if (any(empty_samples)) {
  removed_empty_samples <- colnames(count_mat)[empty_samples]

  warning(
    "Removing empty samples: ",
    paste(removed_empty_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )

  count_mat <- count_mat[, !empty_samples, drop = FALSE]
  sample_info <- sample_info[
    colnames(count_mat),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Create clearer analysis variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_info <- sample_info %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = rownames(.),

    sample_material = case_when(
      dna_type == "beads" ~ "Beads",
      dna_type == "water" & dna_location == "outflow" ~ "Effluent",
      dna_type == "water" & dna_location == "bottle" ~ "Batch culture water",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),

    bead_position = case_when(
      dna_type == "beads" & dna_location == "0cm"  ~ "Bottom",
      dna_type == "beads" & dna_location == "70cm" ~ "Top",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    treatment = case_when(
      trt %in% c("0m", "0 m", "Ambient", "ambient") ~ "Ambient",
      trt %in% c(
        "DiatomLysate",
        "Diatom lysate",
        "diatom lysate"
      ) ~ "Diatom lysate",
      TRUE ~ as.character(trt)
    ),

    incubation_stage = case_when(
      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed == 0 ~ "Batch T0",

      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed > 0 ~ "Batch 96 h",

      sample_material == "Effluent" ~ "Bioreactor effluent",

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Bottom" ~ "Beads — bottom",

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Top" ~ "Beads — top",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample_id

# Explicit factor ordering for subsequent analyses and plots.
sample_info$sample_material <- factor(
  sample_info$sample_material,
  levels = c(
    "Batch culture water",
    "Effluent",
    "Beads"
  )
)

sample_info$bead_position <- factor(
  sample_info$bead_position,
  levels = c("Bottom", "Top")
)

sample_info$treatment <- factor(
  sample_info$treatment,
  levels = c("Ambient", "Diatom lysate")
)

sample_info$incubation_stage <- factor(
  sample_info$incubation_stage,
  levels = c(
    "Batch T0",
    "Batch 96 h",
    "Bioreactor effluent",
    "Beads — bottom",
    "Beads — top"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Construct phyloseq object
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ASV_physeq <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(count_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(tax_mat),
  sample_data(sample_info)
)

cat("Final phyloseq dimensions\n")
cat("  Samples:", nsamples(ASV_physeq), "\n")
cat("  ASVs:", ntaxa(ASV_physeq), "\n\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Sample inventory
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_inventory <- sample_info %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::count(
    sample_material,
    incubation_stage,
    treatment,
    name = "n_samples",
    .drop = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_samples > 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    sample_material,
    incubation_stage,
    treatment
  )

print(sample_inventory, n = Inf)

# Detailed inventory for checking sample identities.
sample_inventory_detailed <- sample_info |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    sample_material,
    incubation_stage,
    treatment,
    bead_position,
    bioreactor,
    bottle,
    hours_elapsed
  )

print(sample_inventory_detailed, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Sequencing-depth audit
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library_sizes <- tibble(
  sample_id = sample_names(ASV_physeq),
  library_size = sample_sums(ASV_physeq)
) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample_id_join") %>%
      select(
        sample_id_join,
        sample_material,
        incubation_stage,
        treatment,
        bead_position,
        bioreactor,
        bottle
      ),
    by = c("sample_id" = "sample_id_join")
  ) %>%
  arrange(library_size)

print(library_sizes, n = Inf)

cat("\nLibrary-size summary\n")
print(
  library_sizes %>%
    summarise(
      n_samples = n(),
      minimum = min(library_size),
      first_quartile = quantile(library_size, 0.25),
      median = median(library_size),
      mean = mean(library_size),
      third_quartile = quantile(library_size, 0.75),
      maximum = max(library_size)
    )
)

# Plot library sizes on a log10 scale.
p_library_size <- ggplot(
  library_sizes,
  aes(
    x = reorder(sample_id, library_size),
    y = library_size,
    fill = incubation_stage
  )
) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_y_log10(
    labels = scales::label_comma()
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "16S rRNA gene reads",
    fill = "Sample group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_library_size

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Replication available for candidate comparisons
# ------------------------------------------------------------

comparison_inventory <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  sample_info %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(sample_material == "Beads") %>%
    dplyr::count(
      comparison = "Bottom versus top beads",
      group = bead_position,
      name = "n"
    ),

  sample_info %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      sample_material %in% c(
        "Beads",
        "Batch culture water",
        "Effluent"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(
      comparison = "Sample material",
      group = sample_material,
      name = "n"
    ),

  sample_info %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(sample_material == "Batch culture water") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      comparison = "Batch treatment and time",
      group = interaction(
        treatment,
        hours_elapsed,
        sep = " — ",
        drop = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(
      comparison,
      group,
      name = "n"
    )
)

comparison_inventory <- tibble::as_tibble(comparison_inventory)

print(comparison_inventory, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Export audit tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(
  sample_inventory,
  "results/community_sample_inventory.csv"
)

write_csv(
  sample_inventory_detailed,
  "results/community_sample_inventory_detailed.csv"
)

write_csv(
  library_sizes,
  "results/community_library_sizes.csv"
)

write_csv(
  comparison_inventory,
  "results/community_comparison_inventory.csv"
)
```


```{r}
 # ============================================================
# Stage 2: Alpha diversity
#
# Notes:
# - The filtered ASV table contains no singletons.
# - Therefore, richness estimators are not interpreted as
#   unbiased estimates of total richness.
# - Shannon and Simpson diversity are the primary metrics.
# - "Retained ASVs" is reported descriptively as the number
#   of ASVs remaining after the applied filtering pipeline.
# - Bottom-versus-top bead comparisons use the five paired
#   bioreactors as the independent experimental units.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Calculate Shannon and Simpson diversity
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alpha_diversity <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(
  ASV_physeq,
  measures = c(
    "Shannon",
    "Simpson"
  )
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate number of retained ASVs per sample
#
# This is descriptive only. It is not interpreted as an
# unbiased richness estimate because the ASV table has already
# undergone low-abundance filtering and contains no singletons.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

otu_mat <- as(
  phyloseq::otu_table(ASV_physeq),
  "matrix"
)

if (phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ASV_physeq)) {

  retained_asvs <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_id = colnames(otu_mat),
    retained_asvs = colSums(otu_mat > 0)
  )

} else {

  retained_asvs <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_id = rownames(otu_mat),
    retained_asvs = rowSums(otu_mat > 0)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Join metadata and library size
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_metadata_alpha <- sample_info %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id_join") %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id_join,
    sample_material,
    incubation_stage,
    treatment,
    bead_position,
    bioreactor,
    bottle,
    hours_elapsed
  )

alpha_diversity <- alpha_diversity %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    retained_asvs,
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_metadata_alpha,
    by = c(
      "sample_id" = "sample_id_join"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    library_sizes %>%
      tibble::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_id,
        library_size
      ),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_group = dplyr::case_when(
      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed == 0 ~
        "Batch T0",

      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed > 0 ~
        "Batch 96 h",

      sample_material == "Effluent" ~
        "Bioreactor effluent",

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Bottom" ~
        "Beads — bottom",

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Top" ~
        "Beads — top",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),

    sample_group = factor(
      sample_group,
      levels = c(
        "Batch T0",
        "Batch 96 h",
        "Bioreactor effluent",
        "Beads — bottom",
        "Beads — top"
      )
    ),

    bead_position = factor(
      bead_position,
      levels = c(
        "Bottom",
        "Top"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

# Inspect complete alpha-diversity table.
print(
  alpha_diversity %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_id,
      sample_group,
      bioreactor,
      retained_asvs,
      Shannon,
      Simpson,
      library_size
    ),
  n = Inf
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Diagnostic relationships with sequencing depth
#
# These tests assess whether the retained alpha-diversity
# metrics remain associated with sequencing depth.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_spearman_test <- function(data, response_variable) {

  complete_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data[[response_variable]]),
      is.finite(library_size)
    )

  test_result <- stats::cor.test(
    x = complete_data[[response_variable]],
    y = complete_data$library_size,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    metric = response_variable,
    n_samples = nrow(complete_data),
    spearman_rho = unname(
      test_result$estimate
    ),
    p_value = test_result$p.value
  )
}

alpha_depth_tests <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  run_spearman_test(
    alpha_diversity,
    "retained_asvs"
  ),
  run_spearman_test(
    alpha_diversity,
    "Shannon"
  ),
  run_spearman_test(
    alpha_diversity,
    "Simpson"
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjusted_bh = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

print(alpha_depth_tests, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare paired bottom-versus-top bead data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bead_alpha <- alpha_diversity %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    sample_material == "Beads",
    !is.na(bead_position),
    !is.na(bioreactor)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    bioreactor = factor(bioreactor)
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

# Verify that each bioreactor contributes one bottom and one
# top bead sample.
bead_pair_check <- bead_alpha %>%
  dplyr::count(
    bioreactor,
    bead_position,
    name = "n_samples",
    .drop = FALSE
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

print(bead_pair_check, n = Inf)

incomplete_pairs <- bead_pair_check %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_samples != 1)

if (nrow(incomplete_pairs) > 0) {
  warning(
    "At least one bioreactor does not contain exactly one ",
    "bottom and one top bead sample."
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Convert paired bead data to long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bead_alpha_long <- bead_alpha %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    bioreactor,
    bead_position,
    retained_asvs,
    Shannon,
    Simpson
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      retained_asvs,
      Shannon,
      Simpson
    ),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c(
        "retained_asvs",
        "Shannon",
        "Simpson"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Descriptive summaries by bead position
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bead_alpha_summary <- bead_alpha_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    metric,
    bead_position
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bioreactors = dplyr::n(),
    mean = mean(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd = stats::sd(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median = stats::median(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    minimum = min(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    maximum = max(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()


print(bead_alpha_summary, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Calculate paired top-minus-bottom differences
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bead_alpha_paired <- bead_alpha_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    bioreactor,
    bead_position,
    metric,
    value
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = bead_position,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    difference_top_minus_bottom =
      Top - Bottom
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

print(bead_alpha_paired, n = Inf)

bead_alpha_difference_summary <- bead_alpha_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pairs = sum(
      is.finite(Bottom) &
        is.finite(Top)
    ),
    mean_difference = mean(
      difference_top_minus_bottom,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd_difference = stats::sd(
      difference_top_minus_bottom,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_difference = stats::median(
      difference_top_minus_bottom,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    minimum_difference = min(
      difference_top_minus_bottom,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    maximum_difference = max(
      difference_top_minus_bottom,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

print(
  bead_alpha_difference_summary,
  n = Inf
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests
#
# There are only five independent bioreactors.
# Tests are therefore interpreted cautiously and paired
# differences remain central to interpretation.
#
# exact = FALSE avoids errors or warnings caused by ties or
# zero differences.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_paired_wilcoxon <- function(
  paired_data,
  metric_name
) {

  metric_data <- paired_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      is.finite(Bottom),
      is.finite(Top)
    )

  if (nrow(metric_data) < 2) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        metric = metric_name,
        n_pairs = nrow(metric_data),
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  test_result <- stats::wilcox.test(
    x = metric_data$Top,
    y = metric_data$Bottom,
    paired = TRUE,
    alternative = "two.sided",
    exact = FALSE,
    conf.int = FALSE
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    metric = metric_name,
    n_pairs = nrow(metric_data),
    statistic = unname(
      test_result$statistic
    ),
    p_value = test_result$p.value
  )
}

bead_alpha_tests <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  run_paired_wilcoxon(
    bead_alpha_paired,
    "retained_asvs"
  ),
  run_paired_wilcoxon(
    bead_alpha_paired,
    "Shannon"
  ),
  run_paired_wilcoxon(
    bead_alpha_paired,
    "Simpson"
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjusted_bh = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

print(bead_alpha_tests, n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# Figure S5: Descriptive alpha diversity by sample material
#
# Retained ASV counts are descriptive because the filtered
# ASV table contains no singleton ASVs.
# Error bars represent SD, not SE.
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare plotting table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

s5_diversity <- alpha_diversity %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dna_type_plot = dplyr::case_when(
      sample_material == "Beads" ~ "Beads",
      sample_material %in% c(
        "Batch culture water",
        "Effluent"
      ) ~ "Water",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    sample_location = dplyr::case_when(
      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Bottom" ~
        "0 cm",

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Top" ~
        "70 cm",

      sample_material == "Batch culture water" ~
        "Bottle",

      sample_material == "Effluent" ~
        "Outflow",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    dna_type_plot = factor(
      dna_type_plot,
      levels = c(
        "Beads",
        "Water"
      )
    ),

    sample_location = factor(
      sample_location,
      levels = c(
        "0 cm",
        "70 cm",
        "Bottle",
        "Outflow"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    dna_type_plot,
    sample_location,
    retained_asvs,
    Shannon
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      retained_asvs,
      Shannon
    ),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(dna_type_plot),
    !is.na(sample_location),
    is.finite(value)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    measure = factor(
      measure,
      levels = c(
        "retained_asvs",
        "Shannon"
      )
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Facet labels and palette
# ------------------------------------------------------------

facet_labs <- c(
  retained_asvs =
    "Retained~ASVs~after~filtering",
  Shannon =
    "Shannon~diversity~(H*\"'\")"
)

pal <- c(
  "0 cm" = "#E69F00",
  "70 cm" = "#009E73",
  "Bottle" = "#0072B2",
  "Outflow" = "#56B4E9"
)

pd <- position_dodge(
  width = 0.65
)

pjd <- position_jitterdodge(
  dodge.width = 0.65,
  jitter.width = 0.10,
  jitter.height = 0
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Summary table used for mean ± SD
#
# Outflow has n = 1, so its SD is undefined and no error bar
# will be drawn.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

s5_summary <- s5_diversity %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    dna_type_plot,
    sample_location,
    measure
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_value = mean(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd_value = if_else(
      n > 1,
      stats::sd(
        value,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(s5_summary, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_s5 <- ggplot(
  s5_diversity,
  aes(
    x = dna_type_plot,
    y = value,
    fill = sample_location
  )
) +

  # Individual samples
  geom_point(
    position = pjd,
    size = 2.0,
    alpha = 0.7,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.45,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # SD among independent samples
  geom_errorbar(
    data = s5_summary,
    aes(
      x = dna_type_plot,
      ymin = mean_value - sd_value,
      ymax = mean_value + sd_value,
      group = sample_location
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    position = pd,
    width = 0.16,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Group mean
  geom_point(
    data = s5_summary,
    aes(
      x = dna_type_plot,
      y = mean_value,
      fill = sample_location,
      group = sample_location
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    position = pd,
    size = 3.4,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal,
    name = "Sample location",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ measure,
    nrow = 1,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(
      measure = as_labeller(
        facet_labs,
        label_parsed
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      vjust = 0.95
    )
  )

p_s5

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save figure and reporting table
# ------------------------------------------------------------


ggsave(
  filename =
    "figures/Figure_S5_alpha_diversity.pdf",
  plot = p_s5,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 4.8
)

readr::write_csv(
  s5_summary,
  "results/Figure_S5_alpha_diversity_summary.csv"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Export results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  alpha_diversity,
  "results/community_alpha_diversity_all_samples.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  alpha_depth_tests,
  "results/community_alpha_library_depth_tests.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  bead_pair_check,
  "results/community_alpha_bead_pair_check.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  bead_alpha_summary,
  "results/community_alpha_bead_position_summary.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  bead_alpha_paired,
  "results/community_alpha_bead_paired_values.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  bead_alpha_difference_summary,
  "results/community_alpha_bead_paired_differences.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  bead_alpha_tests,
  "results/community_alpha_bead_paired_tests.csv"
)

```




```{r}
# ============================================================
# Stage 3: Beta diversity
#
# Analysis structure:
# 1. Descriptive Bray-Curtis PCoA across all samples.
# 2. Paired bottom-versus-top bead comparison.
# 3. PERMDISP diagnostic for bottom versus top bead samples.
# 4. Within-bioreactor bottom-to-top Bray-Curtis distances.
#
# Important:
# - Relative abundance is used for Bray-Curtis distances.
# - The single bioreactor-effluent sample is displayed but is
#   not included in inferential comparisons.
# - Bottom-versus-top testing is restricted within bioreactor.
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(permute)
library(ggplot2)

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

set.seed(12345)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Convert ASV counts to relative abundance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ASV_physeq_rel <- phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(
  ASV_physeq,
  function(x) {
    total <- sum(x)

    if (total == 0) {
      return(x)
    }

    x / total
  }
)

# Confirm every non-empty sample sums to approximately 1.
relative_abundance_sums <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = phyloseq::sample_names(ASV_physeq_rel),
  relative_abundance_sum =
    phyloseq::sample_sums(ASV_physeq_rel)
)

print(relative_abundance_sums)

if (
  any(
    abs(
      relative_abundance_sums$relative_abundance_sum - 1
    ) > 1e-8
  )
) {
  warning(
    "At least one relative-abundance sample does not sum to 1."
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate Bray-Curtis distance across all samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bray_all <- phyloseq::distance(
  ASV_physeq_rel,
  method = "bray"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. PCoA across all samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pcoa_all <- phyloseq::ordinate(
  ASV_physeq_rel,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = bray_all
)

# Extract percentage variation explained.
pcoa_all_eigenvalues <- pcoa_all$values$Relative_eig

pcoa_all_axis1_pct <- 100 * pcoa_all_eigenvalues[1]
pcoa_all_axis2_pct <- 100 * pcoa_all_eigenvalues[2]

pcoa_all_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pcoa_all$vectors[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Axis1 = Axis.1,
    Axis2 = Axis.2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_info %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id_join") %>%
      tibble::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_id_join,
        sample_material,
        incubation_stage,
        treatment,
        bead_position,
        bioreactor,
        bottle,
        hours_elapsed
      ),
    by = c("sample_id" = "sample_id_join")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_group = dplyr::case_when(
      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed == 0 ~
        "Batch T0",

      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed > 0 ~
        "Batch 96 h",

      sample_material == "Effluent" ~
        "Bioreactor effluent",

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Bottom" ~
        "Beads — bottom",

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Top" ~
        "Beads — top",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),

    sample_group = factor(
      sample_group,
      levels = c(
        "Batch T0",
        "Batch 96 h",
        "Bioreactor effluent",
        "Beads — bottom",
        "Beads — top"
      )
    )
  )

print(pcoa_all_scores, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot all samples descriptively
#
# No confidence ellipses are used because:
# - group sizes are very small;
# - the effluent group contains only one sample;
# - the purpose is descriptive visualization.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_group_colors <- c(
  "Batch T0" = "#56B4E9",
  "Batch 96 h" = "#0072B2",
  "Bioreactor effluent" = "#CC79A7",
  "Beads — bottom" = "#E69F00",
  "Beads — top" = "#009E73"
)

sample_group_shapes <- c(
  "Batch T0" = 21,
  "Batch 96 h" = 22,
  "Bioreactor effluent" = 23,
  "Beads — bottom" = 24,
  "Beads — top" = 25
)

p_beta_all <- ggplot(
  pcoa_all_scores,
  aes(
    x = Axis1,
    y = Axis2,
    fill = sample_group,
    shape = sample_group
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "grey75"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "grey75"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3.6,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = sample_group_colors,
    name = "Sample group",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = sample_group_shapes,
    name = "Sample group",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0(
      "PCoA axis 1 (",
      round(pcoa_all_axis1_pct, 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PCoA axis 2 (",
      round(pcoa_all_axis2_pct, 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Bray–Curtis distances calculated from",
      "relative-abundance ASV profiles."
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_beta_all

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create bead-only phyloseq object
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ASV_beads_rel <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ASV_physeq_rel,
  sample_material == "Beads" &
    !is.na(bead_position) &
    !is.na(bioreactor)
)

# Remove ASVs absent from all retained bead samples.
ASV_beads_rel <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(
  phyloseq::taxa_sums(ASV_beads_rel) > 0,
  ASV_beads_rel
)

cat(
  "Bead-only samples:",
  phyloseq::nsamples(ASV_beads_rel),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Bead-only ASVs:",
  phyloseq::ntaxa(ASV_beads_rel),
  "\n"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Construct bead metadata in exact phyloseq sample order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bead_sample_order <- phyloseq::sample_names(
  ASV_beads_rel
)

bead_meta <- data.frame(
  phyloseq::sample_data(ASV_beads_rel)
) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    bead_position = factor(
      bead_position,
      levels = c("Bottom", "Top")
    ),
    bioreactor = factor(bioreactor)
  )
# Force metadata into the exact order used by the distance matrix.
bead_meta <- bead_meta %>%
  dplyr::slice(
    match(
      bead_sample_order,
      sample_id
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  identical(
    bead_meta$sample_id,
    bead_sample_order
  )
)

print(
  bead_meta %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_id,
      bioreactor,
      bead_position
    ),
  n = Inf
)

# Verify one bottom and one top sample per bioreactor.
bead_pair_inventory <- bead_meta %>%
  dplyr::count(
    bioreactor,
    bead_position,
    name = "n_samples",
    .drop = FALSE
  )

print(bead_pair_inventory, n = Inf)

if (
  any(
    bead_pair_inventory$n_samples != 1
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Each bioreactor must contain exactly one bottom and ",
    "one top sample for the paired beta-diversity test."
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Bray-Curtis distance among bead samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bray_beads <- phyloseq::distance(
  ASV_beads_rel,
  method = "bray"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Bead-only PCoA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pcoa_beads <- phyloseq::ordinate(
  ASV_beads_rel,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = bray_beads
)

pcoa_bead_eigenvalues <- pcoa_beads$values$Relative_eig

pcoa_bead_axis1_pct <- 100 * pcoa_bead_eigenvalues[1]
pcoa_bead_axis2_pct <- 100 * pcoa_bead_eigenvalues[2]

pcoa_bead_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pcoa_beads$vectors[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Axis1 = Axis.1,
    Axis2 = Axis.2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    bead_meta %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_id,
        bioreactor,
        bead_position
      ),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

print(pcoa_bead_scores, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Plot paired bead samples
#
# Lines connect the bottom and top sample from the same
# independent bioreactor.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_beta_beads <- ggplot(
  pcoa_bead_scores,
  aes(
    x = Axis1,
    y = Axis2
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "grey75"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "grey75"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      group = bioreactor
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.55,
    color = "grey35"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      fill = bead_position,
      shape = bead_position
    ),
    size = 4,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Bottom" = "#E69F00",
      "Top" = "#009E73"
    ),
    name = "Bead position"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Bottom" = 21,
      "Top" = 24
    ),
    name = "Bead position"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0(
      "PCoA axis 1 (",
      round(pcoa_bead_axis1_pct, 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PCoA axis 2 (",
      round(pcoa_bead_axis2_pct, 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Lines connect bottom and top samples from",
      "the same independent bioreactor."
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_beta_beads

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. PERMDISP: bottom versus top bead communities
#
# PERMDISP asks whether the two positions differ in
# multivariate dispersion. A significant result would make
# PERMANOVA centroid differences harder to interpret.
#
# This diagnostic is not naturally paired, so it is interpreted
# cautiously alongside the paired PERMANOVA.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bead_dispersion <- vegan::betadisper(
  bray_beads,
  group = bead_meta$bead_position,
  type = "centroid"
)

bead_permdisp_anova <- anova(
  bead_dispersion
)

set.seed(12345)

bead_permdisp_permutation <- vegan::permutest(
  bead_dispersion,
  permutations = 9999,
  pairwise = FALSE
)

print(bead_permdisp_anova)
print(bead_permdisp_permutation)

bead_permdisp_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  comparison = "Bottom versus top beads",
  method = "PERMDISP",
  statistic_F =
    unname(
      bead_permdisp_permutation$tab[1, "F"]
    ),
  p_value =
    unname(
      bead_permdisp_permutation$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"]
    )
)

print(bead_permdisp_summary)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Paired PERMANOVA
#
# Permutations are restricted within bioreactor so that each
# bottom sample is exchangeable only with its paired top sample.
#
# With five paired bioreactors, there are at most 2^5 = 32
# unique within-pair label arrangements, so the attainable
# permutation p-values are necessarily coarse.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

permutation_control <- permute::how(
  nperm = 9999
)

permute::setBlocks(
  permutation_control
) <- bead_meta$bioreactor

set.seed(12345)

bead_permanova <- vegan::adonis2(
  bray_beads ~ bead_position,
  data = as.data.frame(bead_meta),
  permutations = permutation_control,
  by = "margin"
)

print(bead_permanova)

bead_permanova_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  comparison = "Bottom versus top beads",
  method = "Paired PERMANOVA",
  df = bead_permanova[
    "bead_position",
    "Df"
  ],
  sum_of_squares = bead_permanova[
    "bead_position",
    "SumOfSqs"
  ],
  r_squared = bead_permanova[
    "bead_position",
    "R2"
  ],
  statistic_F = bead_permanova[
    "bead_position",
    "F"
  ],
  p_value = bead_permanova[
    "bead_position",
    "Pr(>F)"
  ]
)

print(bead_permanova_summary)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Calculate paired bottom-to-top Bray-Curtis distance
#     for each bioreactor
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bray_bead_matrix <- as.matrix(
  bray_beads
)

bead_pairs <- bead_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    bioreactor,
    bead_position
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = bead_position,
    values_from = sample_id
  )

paired_bray_distances <- bead_pairs %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    bray_curtis_bottom_top =
      bray_bead_matrix[
        Bottom,
        Top
      ]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

print(paired_bray_distances, n = Inf)

paired_bray_summary <- paired_bray_distances %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bioreactors = dplyr::n(),
    mean_bray_curtis = mean(
      bray_curtis_bottom_top
    ),
    sd_bray_curtis = stats::sd(
      bray_curtis_bottom_top
    ),
    median_bray_curtis = stats::median(
      bray_curtis_bottom_top
    ),
    minimum_bray_curtis = min(
      bray_curtis_bottom_top
    ),
    maximum_bray_curtis = max(
      bray_curtis_bottom_top
    )
  )

print(paired_bray_summary)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Optional descriptive treatment comparison in bottles
#
# This section does not perform inference. There is one T0
# sample per treatment and two 96-h bottle replicates per
# treatment, which is insufficient for a robust treatment-by-
# time community analysis.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

batch_beta_scores <- pcoa_all_scores %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    sample_material == "Batch culture water"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    Axis1,
    Axis2,
    treatment,
    hours_elapsed,
    bottle
  )

print(batch_beta_scores, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Export tables and figures
# ------------------------------------------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  pcoa_all_scores,
  "results/community_beta_pcoa_all_samples.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  pcoa_bead_scores,
  "results/community_beta_pcoa_beads.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  bead_permdisp_summary,
  "results/community_beta_bead_permdisp.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  bead_permanova_summary,
  "results/community_beta_bead_paired_permanova.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  paired_bray_distances,
  "results/community_beta_paired_bray_distances.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  paired_bray_summary,
  "results/community_beta_paired_bray_summary.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  batch_beta_scores,
  "results/community_beta_batch_descriptive_scores.csv"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename =
    "figures/Figure_S6_community_beta_all_samples.pdf",
  plot = p_beta_all,
  width = 7.8,
  height = 6.2
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename =
    "figures/Figure_community_beta_bead_paired.pdf",
  plot = p_beta_beads,
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Stage 4: Taxonomic composition and differential abundance
#
# Outputs:
#   Figure 6a: phylum composition across all samples
#   Figure 6b: Planctomycetota and Thermoproteota family
#              composition in bead-associated communities
#   ASV-level paired DESeq2 results: Top versus Bottom
#   Family summaries of significant ASVs
#
# Statistical design:
#   ~ bioreactor + bead_position
#
# This accounts for the paired design: one bottom and one top
# bead sample from each of five independent bioreactors.
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(DESeq2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

set.seed(12345)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Identify taxonomy rank names robustly
# ------------------------------------------------------------

taxonomy_ranks <- phyloseq::rank_names(ASV_physeq)

phylum_rank <- taxonomy_ranks[
  tolower(taxonomy_ranks) == "phylum"
][1]

family_rank <- taxonomy_ranks[
  tolower(taxonomy_ranks) == "family"
][1]

if (is.na(phylum_rank)) {
  stop("No taxonomy rank matching 'Phylum' was found.")
}

if (is.na(family_rank)) {
  stop("No taxonomy rank matching 'Family' was found.")
}

cat("Phylum rank:", phylum_rank, "\n")
cat("Family rank:", family_rank, "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Clean taxonomy labels
#
# Replace missing or blank taxonomy labels before agglomeration.
# Also correct the legacy spelling Thermoprotetoa.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tax_clean <- as(
  phyloseq::tax_table(ASV_physeq),
  "matrix"
)

tax_clean[, phylum_rank] <- as.character(
  tax_clean[, phylum_rank]
)

tax_clean[, family_rank] <- as.character(
  tax_clean[, family_rank]
)

tax_clean[, phylum_rank][
  is.na(tax_clean[, phylum_rank]) |
    tax_clean[, phylum_rank] == ""
] <- "Unclassified phylum"

tax_clean[, phylum_rank][
  tax_clean[, phylum_rank] == "Thermoprotetoa"
] <- "Thermoproteota"

tax_clean[, family_rank][
  is.na(tax_clean[, family_rank]) |
    tax_clean[, family_rank] == ""
] <- "Unclassified family"

# Collapse any incertae sedis labels to one family-level label
# within the corresponding phylum.
incertae_rows <- grepl(
  "incertae",
  tax_clean[, family_rank],
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

tax_clean[incertae_rows, family_rank] <- paste0(
  "Incertae sedis (",
  tax_clean[incertae_rows, phylum_rank],
  ")"
)

ASV_physeq_tax <- ASV_physeq
phyloseq::tax_table(ASV_physeq_tax) <- phyloseq::tax_table(
  tax_clean
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create consistent sample labels and ordering
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_plot_metadata <- sample_info %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id_row") %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = dplyr::coalesce(
      as.character(sample_id),
      sample_id_row
    ),

    sample_group = dplyr::case_when(
      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed == 0 &
        treatment == "Ambient" ~
        "Batch T0 — ambient",

      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed == 0 &
        treatment == "Diatom lysate" ~
        "Batch T0 — diatom lysate",

      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed > 0 &
        treatment == "Ambient" ~
        paste0("Batch 96 h — ambient — ", bottle),

      sample_material == "Batch culture water" &
        hours_elapsed > 0 &
        treatment == "Diatom lysate" ~
        paste0("Batch 96 h — diatom lysate — ", bottle),

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Bottom" ~
        paste0("BR", bioreactor, " — bottom"),

      sample_material == "Beads" &
        bead_position == "Top" ~
        paste0("BR", bioreactor, " — top"),

      sample_material == "Effluent" ~
        "Five-column effluent",

      TRUE ~ sample_id
    )
  )

# Preserve the original curated metadata order.
sample_levels <- sample_plot_metadata$sample_group

sample_label_map <- setNames(
  sample_plot_metadata$sample_group,
  sample_plot_metadata$sample_id
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Helper function: convert a phyloseq object to relative
#    abundance while preserving zero-count samples safely
# ------------------------------------------------------------

to_relative_abundance <- function(ps_object) {

  phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(
    ps_object,
    function(x) {
      total <- sum(x)

      if (total == 0) {
        return(x)
      }

      x / total
    }
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Figure 6a: Phylum composition across all samples
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Agglomerate to phylum and calculate relative abundance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

phylum_ps <- phyloseq::tax_glom(
  ASV_physeq_tax,
  taxrank = phylum_rank,
  NArm = FALSE
)

phylum_rel_ps <- to_relative_abundance(phylum_ps)

phylum_long <- phyloseq::psmelt(
  phylum_rel_ps
) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

# Remove metadata columns carried into psmelt().
# Sample and Abundance remain the authoritative columns from
# the phyloseq object.
phylum_long <- phylum_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample,
    Abundance,
    dplyr::all_of(phylum_rank)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id = Sample,
    relative_abundance = Abundance
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Phylum = as.character(
      .data[[phylum_rank]]
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    relative_abundance,
    Phylum
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_plot_metadata %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_id,
        sample_group,
        sample_material,
        bead_position,
        treatment,
        hours_elapsed
      ),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

# Confirm that the expected columns are now present.
stopifnot(
  all(
    c(
      "sample_id",
      "relative_abundance",
      "Phylum",
      "sample_group",
      "sample_material",
      "bead_position",
      "treatment",
      "hours_elapsed"
    ) %in% names(phylum_long)
  )
)

names(phylum_long)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Retain phyla reaching at least 5% in any sample;
#    combine the remainder as "Other"
# ------------------------------------------------------------

major_phyla <- phylum_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Phylum) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    maximum_relative_abundance = max(
      relative_abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    maximum_relative_abundance >= 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Phylum)

phylum_plot_data <- phylum_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Phylum_plot = dplyr::if_else(
      Phylum %in% major_phyla,
      Phylum,
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample_id,
    sample_group,
    sample_material,
    bead_position,
    treatment,
    hours_elapsed,
    Phylum_plot
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    relative_abundance = sum(
      relative_abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_group = factor(
      sample_group,
      levels = sample_levels
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Order phyla in the legend
#
# Highlight Planctomycetota and Thermoproteota, then order the
# remaining major phyla by maximum relative abundance.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

highlight_phyla <- intersect(
  c(
    "Planctomycetota",
    "Thermoproteota"
  ),
  unique(phylum_plot_data$Phylum_plot)
)

remaining_phyla <- phylum_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !Phylum_plot %in% c(
      highlight_phyla,
      "Other",
      "Unclassified phylum"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Phylum_plot) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    maximum_abundance = max(
      relative_abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(maximum_abundance)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Phylum_plot)

special_phyla <- intersect(
  c(
    "Unclassified phylum",
    "Other"
  ),
  unique(phylum_plot_data$Phylum_plot)
)

phylum_levels <- c(
  highlight_phyla,
  remaining_phyla,
  special_phyla
)

phylum_plot_data <- phylum_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Phylum_plot = factor(
      Phylum_plot,
      levels = phylum_levels
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Phylum colors
# ------------------------------------------------------------

phylum_highlight_colors <- c(
  "Planctomycetota" = "#3E8FB0",
  "Thermoproteota" = "#D95F02"
)

remaining_greys <- grDevices::gray.colors(
  n = length(remaining_phyla),
  start = 0.20,
  end = 0.78
)

names(remaining_greys) <- remaining_phyla

special_colors <- c(
  "Unclassified phylum" = "#BEBEBE",
  "Other" = "#D9D9D9"
)

phylum_colors <- c(
  phylum_highlight_colors[
    names(phylum_highlight_colors) %in% highlight_phyla
  ],
  remaining_greys,
  special_colors[
    names(special_colors) %in% special_phyla
  ]
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Plot phylum composition
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_phylum <- ggplot(
  phylum_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = sample_group,
    y = relative_abundance,
    fill = Phylum_plot
  )
) +
  geom_col(

  ) +

    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.02)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 55,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) + 
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
        nrow = 2,
        byrow = TRUE
    )
)

p_phylum

# ============================================================
# Paired ASV-level differential abundance
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Create bead-only raw count and metadata matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bead_ps_raw <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ASV_physeq_tax,
  sample_material == "Beads" &
    !is.na(bead_position) &
    !is.na(bioreactor)
)

bead_ps_raw <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(
  phyloseq::taxa_sums(bead_ps_raw) > 0,
  bead_ps_raw
)

bead_count_matrix <- as(
  phyloseq::otu_table(bead_ps_raw),
  "matrix"
)

if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(bead_ps_raw)) {
  bead_count_matrix <- t(
    bead_count_matrix
  )
}

storage.mode(bead_count_matrix) <- "integer"

bead_deseq_metadata <- data.frame(
  phyloseq::sample_data(bead_ps_raw)
) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

# sample_id already exists from Stage 1. Add it defensively if
# needed.
if (!"sample_id" %in% names(bead_deseq_metadata)) {

  bead_deseq_metadata$sample_id <-
    phyloseq::sample_names(
      bead_ps_raw
    )
}

# Match metadata order to the count-matrix columns.
bead_deseq_metadata <- bead_deseq_metadata %>%
  dplyr::slice(
    match(
      colnames(bead_count_matrix),
      sample_id
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    bioreactor = factor(
      bioreactor
    ),

    bead_position = factor(
      bead_position,
      levels = c(
        "Bottom",
        "Top"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(bead_deseq_metadata) <-
  bead_deseq_metadata$sample_id

stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(bead_count_matrix),
    rownames(bead_deseq_metadata)
  )
)

# Confirm paired structure.
bead_deseq_pair_check <- bead_deseq_metadata %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "sample_id_check"
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::count(
    bioreactor,
    bead_position,
    name = "n",
    .drop = FALSE
  )

print(
  bead_deseq_pair_check,
  n = Inf
)

if (any(bead_deseq_pair_check$n != 1)) {
  stop(
    "DESeq2 requires one bottom and one top sample ",
    "from each bioreactor."
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Filter extremely sparse ASVs before DESeq2
#
# Retain ASVs with at least 10 reads in at least two bead
# samples. This reduces uninformative multiple testing without
# imposing an effect-size filter.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

keep_asvs <- rowSums(
  bead_count_matrix >= 10
) >= 2

bead_count_matrix_filtered <-
  bead_count_matrix[
    keep_asvs,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

cat(
  "ASVs before DESeq2 filtering:",
  nrow(bead_count_matrix),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "ASVs after DESeq2 filtering:",
  nrow(bead_count_matrix_filtered),
  "\n"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Fit paired DESeq2 model
#
# Top-versus-bottom effect is estimated after controlling for
# the identity of each bioreactor.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dds_asv <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = bead_count_matrix_filtered,
  colData = bead_deseq_metadata,
  design = ~ bioreactor + bead_position
)

dds_asv <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(
  dds_asv,
  type = "poscounts"
)

dds_asv <- DESeq2::DESeq(
  dds_asv,
  fitType = "parametric"
)

DESeq2::resultsNames(
  dds_asv
)

res_asv <- DESeq2::results(
  dds_asv,
  contrast = c(
    "bead_position",
    "Top",
    "Bottom"
  ),
  alpha = 0.05
)

# Positive log2 fold change means enrichment at the top.
# Negative log2 fold change means enrichment at the bottom.

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Join ASV-level DESeq2 results to taxonomy
# ------------------------------------------------------------

taxonomy_table <- as.data.frame(
  phyloseq::tax_table(
    ASV_physeq_tax
  )
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "ASV"
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

res_asv_tax <- as.data.frame(
  res_asv
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "ASV"
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    taxonomy_table,
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(padj) ~ "Not tested or unresolved",
      padj >= 0.05 ~ "Not significant",
      log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Enriched at top",
      log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Enriched at bottom",
      TRUE ~ "No directional change"
    ),

    significant = !is.na(padj) &
      padj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    padj,
    dplyr::desc(
      abs(log2FoldChange)
    )
  )

res_asv_significant <- res_asv_tax %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significant
  )

cat(
  "Significant ASVs at FDR < 0.05:",
  nrow(res_asv_significant),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Enriched at top:",
  sum(
    res_asv_significant$log2FoldChange > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Enriched at bottom:",
  sum(
    res_asv_significant$log2FoldChange < 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Summarize significant ASVs by family
#
# This is a descriptive aggregation of significant ASV-level
# results. It is not a separate family-level statistical test.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

significant_family_summary <- res_asv_significant %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Family_summary = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(.data[[family_rank]]) |
        .data[[family_rank]] == "",
      paste0(
        "Unclassified family (",
        .data[[phylum_rank]],
        ")"
      ),
      as.character(
        .data[[family_rank]]
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Phylum = .data[[phylum_rank]],
    Family = Family_summary,
    direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_significant_asvs = dplyr::n(),
    median_log2_fold_change = median(
      log2FoldChange,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    minimum_adjusted_p = min(
      padj,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      n_significant_asvs
    ),
    minimum_adjusted_p
  )

print(
  significant_family_summary,
  n = Inf
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Create concise top-hit tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top_asv_hits <- res_asv_significant %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ASV,
    all_of(phylum_rank),
    all_of(family_rank),
    log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE,
    pvalue,
    padj,
    direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = 20
  )

top_family_hits <- significant_family_summary %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = 20
  )

print(
  top_asv_hits,
  n = Inf
)

print(
  top_family_hits,
  n = Inf
)

# ============================================================
# Export figures and reporting tables
# ============================================================

readr::write_csv(
  phylum_plot_data,
  "results/Figure6a_phylum_composition_data.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  family_bead_plot_data,
  "results/Figure6b_family_composition_data.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  res_asv_tax,
  "results/community_deseq2_asv_all_results.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  res_asv_significant,
  "results/community_deseq2_asv_significant.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  significant_family_summary,
  "results/community_deseq2_significant_asvs_by_family.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  top_asv_hits,
  "results/community_deseq2_top_asv_hits.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  top_family_hits,
  "results/community_deseq2_top_family_summaries.csv"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = "figures/Figure_6_community_composition.pdf",
  plot = fig6,
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

```
